review_scope: Exploratory, non-Gold gate-node review data. Existing v2 gate scopes are retained unless explicitly amended by v8. v8-reviewed event cause sets and fault-cause-mode sets are reconciled with exact source spans; not_applicable scopes remain excluded. AI role review is not human expert sign-off, formal Gold, field-instance observation, event probability, or production FTA authorization.
supersession_reason: v8 scope amendments replace stale child sets, update scope_type where the reviewed range changed, preserve excluded/not_applicable cases without gate labels, and add reviewed v8 scopes absent from v2. Source-cluster splits are recomputed from reviewed nodes.
split_policy: deterministic source_sha256 cluster split; all scopes from identical source text stay together
